title: AeroStep: Pedometer & Step AI
short_description: Accurate offline step counter with zero GPS drain, smart walk coach & widgets
full_description:
AeroStep is a pedometer, step counter and walking tracker that uses your phone's built-in step sensor. It never uses GPS and runs no background service, so it won't drain your battery, and it works fully offline.

WHY AEROSTEP COUNTS MORE ACCURATELY
• Anti-shake filter: steps only count after a real walking rhythm (60–220 steps per minute) is held for several seconds. Shaking your phone, picking it up or tapping it doesn't add fake steps.
• Vehicle auto-pause: AeroStep recognises when you're in a car, bus or on a bike and pauses counting, so bumpy rides don't inflate your total.
• Counts even when the app is closed: your phone's step sensor keeps counting, and AeroStep adds those steps the next time you open it.
• No double counting: connect Health Connect (Android) or Apple Health (iOS) and steps from your smartwatch and phone are merged in 15-minute blocks, so the same walk is never counted twice.
• Travel-proof history: every step is stored with its time zone, so flying across time zones never breaks your daily totals or your streak.

NO MISSED STEPS ON AGGRESSIVE PHONES
Some phones stop background apps aggressively. AeroStep doesn't depend on staying alive: the hardware step counter does the counting, and the 1-tap battery setup opens the right settings for Samsung, Xiaomi, Oppo, Realme, Vivo and OnePlus.

YOUR DAY AT A GLANCE
• Daily step goal ring with distance, active time and calories burned
• Hourly walking rhythm chart and weekly trends (day, week, month, year)
• Live walk mode with a session timer, distance, cadence and pace
• Hydration tracker with 1-tap +250 ml logging
• Home-screen widgets: a 2x2 step ring and a 4x2 dashboard with a water button
• Warm light theme and an espresso dark mode

A WALKING APP FOR WEIGHT LOSS GOALS
See calories burned from your steps, keep your water intake on track and use live walk mode to build a brisk, steady pace day after day.

STREAKS THAT FORGIVE A REST DAY
Hit your goal to grow your streak. Streak Shields automatically protect your streak on a rest day. Earn an extra shield by choosing to watch a short video.

STRIDE COACH
Get personalised tips on the device about the steps left to your goal, hydration, cadence and rest days. Practise your rhythm with the Interval Cadence Drill metronome (adjustable BPM with click and vibration).

KINETIC STEP BINGO
Turn your week into a game with a 3x3 bingo card of walking challenges.

NO POPUP ADS. EVER.
AeroStep never shows ads when you open the app or switch screens. The only ads are optional reward videos that you choose to watch to unlock a Streak Shield or a 24-hour Trail Pass.

PRIVACY FIRST
• No account needed
• Your activity data stays on your phone
• Health Connect / Apple Health data is read only to show and merge your steps; it is never sold, shared or used for advertising

AeroStep is a general fitness and wellness app, not a medical device. Step, distance and calorie figures are estimates.

Privacy policy: https://sunilkumar101.github.io/aerostep_ai/privacy-policy.html
